name: – After § 18 – Am 9
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the escalation of Russian strikes in the EU, particularly on Black Sea shipping, threatening human life, regional stability and food security
part_text: 18a. Calls on the VP/HR, the Council and the Member States to launch an urgent diplomatic initiative, together with the UN, to re-establish a negotiated maritime safety arrangement for the Black Sea, based on the experience of the Black Sea Grain Initiative guaranteeing the safe passage of food and fertiliser exports for all;
